en.t: I probably took about ten photographs.

units.source_text: 我一边按照摄影师的指点，打开快门，试着用手掌遮挡替代快门进行拍摄，一边暗自祷告快门不要中途卡住。

en.t: Following the photographer's instructions, I opened the shutter and tried taking pictures by using my palm as a makeshift shutter, all the while secretly praying that the shutter would not jam halfway through.

units.source_text: 虽然很想多变换些拍摄的方向和角度，但我是一心来礼拜的，不能冒冒失失地在遗体周围随便走动，只能在一个地方坐定。

en.t: Although I wanted very much to change the direction and angle of the shots more, I had come with my whole heart set on paying my respects, so I could not rashly walk around the body at will and could only sit still in one place.
